verdict.rationale: Whether a managed relay service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never shows Cloudflare MoQ Relay's source code or a license. The only GitHub link (moq-interop-runner) is a separate testing tool, not the relay's own source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
